entries.corroboration: decided by Akul Mehta on 2026-11-04: US9777001B2, Orally bioavailable amine-linked macrocyclic inhibitor of factor XIa or factor VIIa, and use thereof. The patent record lists thirteen inventors (Corte, De Lucca, Fang, Yang, Wang, Dilger, Pabbisetty, Ewing, Zhu, Wexler, Pinto, Orwat, Smith) and the itemprop assignee is Bristol Myers Squibb Co. Scholar s BibTeX for the row gives the first ten of them followed by an abbreviation. None of the thirteen shares a surname with the five authors of the cited SPGG paper in the Journal of Medicinal Chemistry, and neither PI is named, so the patent cites the paper independently. The row was queued only because Scholar truncated the inventor list.
